items.title: Unit 4 · Story
items.scene: She uses a net to catch ___.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: She uses a net to catch fish.
items.storyText: Brad and his family live on Dolphin Bay. They play catch on the beach and look for shells. Brad's mom works on a big ship. She uses a net to catch fish. His dad trains dolphins. People come to see them swim. Brad works on the bay, too. Today, he sees a white whale! It's fun to live on Dolphin Bay.
items.why: In “Dolphin Bay”, you hear: She uses a net to catch fish. The missing word is “fish”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 4, p.39 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
items.storySentence: She uses a net to catch fish.
